trailhead.label: La Molière car park at the end of the forest road, the board’s start

cautions: Working alpage: several hundred heifers graze in summer, and guard dogs may be with flocks; keep your dog on a lead and walk round the herd calmly.
Open plateau at about 1,600–1,700 m with quick weather changes and cliffs on the edge near Charande.
On summer weekends and holidays (11 July to 16 August in 2026) the road to La Molière is closed to cars from 10 am to 7 pm: come by the paying shuttle from La Sure.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
